headline: Gyftr Limited informs exchange about postal ballot notice
hook: Postal ballot notice issued by Gyftr
summary: Gyftr Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding the issuance of a postal ballot notice to its shareholders. The notice initiates a voting process on resolutions requiring shareholder approval without holding a physical meeting. Details regarding the specific resolutions to be voted upon were not disclosed in the brief exchange filing. Shareholders will need to review the formal notice to participate in the remote e-voting process.
whats_next: Completion of postal ballot voting and announcement of results
why_it_matters: Shareholders must review postal ballot details to exercise voting rights.

headline: Gyftr shares jump 14.5% ahead of Q2 results announcement
hook: Market reacts to Gyftr's upcoming earnings date
summary: Shares of digital gift card provider Gyftr rose 14.5% following the company's announcement of a board meeting date to declare its Q2 2026 financial results. The price surge reflects market anticipation surrounding the upcoming earnings report. Retail investors should note that such volatility is common ahead of scheduled corporate disclosures.
whats_next: Board meeting to declare Q2 2026 results
why_it_matters: Earnings announcements often trigger significant short-term stock price volatility.
